nota: Diccionario post-build del contenido editorial F2. Cada clave es una cadena española exacta del HTML canónico de /problemas, /como-trabajamos o /cofundadores; cada valor es su traducción inglesa. Las URL no se traducen.

strings.El manifiesto fija ocho frentes. No ofre: The manifesto sets out eight areas of focus. We do not offer a ready-made answer to any of them. We begin by separating what we know from what we want to test.
strings.describe hechos y enlaza su fuente públi: describes facts and links to its public source.
strings.expresa una dirección de trabajo, no un: sets out a direction of work, not a claim of results already achieved. Sources were reviewed on 3 August 2026.
strings.La salida no empieza el día de la excarc: Release does not begin on the day someone leaves prison; it must be prepared for in advance.
strings.La Constitución establece que las penas: The Spanish Constitution states that custodial sentences must be directed towards re-education and social reintegration. It also preserves fundamental rights that have not been expressly restricted and recognises the right to paid work, culture and the full development of the individual
strings.BOE, artículo 25.2 de la Constitución: Official State Gazette, Article 25.2 of the Spanish Constitution
strings.La Ley 16/2003 estableció un plazo de di: Law 16/2003 set an eighteen-month deadline to complete the integration of prison healthcare into regional health services. By 2024, integration had been completed in Catalonia, the Basque Country and Navarre; the Ministry of the Interior still treated it as a strategic objective across the rest of its remit
strings.Generalitat de Cataluña, integración de: Government of Catalonia, integration of prison healthcare
strings.Ministerio del Interior, Informe General: Ministry of the Interior, 2024 General Report
strings.En la encuesta penitenciaria de 2022, el: In the 2022 prison survey, 34.8% of people in prison said they had at some point been diagnosed with a mental or emotional disorder. This is self-reported data and does not establish that imprisonment caused those conditions
strings.Ministerio de Sanidad, ESDIP 2022: Ministry of Health, ESDIP 2022 prison survey
strings.Diseñar continuidad entre salud, educaci: Design continuity across health, education, work, housing and support before and after release. Measure a genuine return to an independent life, not only the activity completed inside prison.
strings.El foco no es hablar más, sino atender a: The focus is not more conversation, but earlier, better and continuous care.
strings.El Informe Anual del Sistema Nacional de: The 2023 Annual Report of Spain's National Health System states that, using 2022 primary-care data, 34.3% of the population had a recorded mental or behavioural disorder. Age-adjusted prevalence was 33% higher than in 2016
strings.Ministerio de Sanidad, resumen ejecutivo: Ministry of Health, executive summary of the 2023 Annual Report of the National Health System
strings.En el Barómetro Sanitario de 2025, el 19: In the 2025 Health Barometer, 19.9% of the adult population said they had needed to consult a professional about a health problem or emotional distress during the previous twelve months
strings.Ministerio de Sanidad, resultados global: Ministry of Health, overall results of the 2025 Health Barometer
strings.El Plan de Acción de Salud Mental 2025-2: The 2025–2027 Mental Health Action Plan includes strengthening the workforce, widening access to psychotherapy, developing community alternatives to institutionalisation and improving information systems
strings.Ministerio de Sanidad, Plan de Acción de: Ministry of Health, Mental Health Action Plan 2025–2027
strings.Construir acceso temprano y seguimiento: Build early access and continuous follow-up around the person. Measure time to first care, continuity, functional recovery and the ability to sustain everyday life.
strings.3. Jóvenes y acceso al trabajo: 3. Young people and access to work
strings.El primer empleo no debería ser una lote: A first job should not be a lottery or a sequence of courses with no real responsibility.
strings.En 2025, el 18,6 % de la población activ: In 2025, 18.6% of Spain's labour force aged 15 to 29 was unemployed, compared with 11.7% in the European Union. It was the highest rate among all European Union member states for that age group. The rate is calculated over young people in the labour force, not the entire youth population
strings.Eurostat, Unemployment statistics and be: Eurostat, Unemployment statistics and beyond, data extracted in May 2026
strings.Del total de contratos registrados en 20: Of all contracts registered in 2025 for people under 30, 59.26% were temporary. The figure counts contracts rather than individuals, so one person may appear more than once
strings.SEPE, Informe del Mercado de Trabajo de: Spanish Public Employment Service, 2026 Youth Labour Market Report
strings.Crear puentes cortos entre aprendizaje y: Create short bridges between learning and paid work: a real problem, a clear responsibility, a person who provides support and evidence of what was produced. Measure access, learning, retention and progression—not attendance at a programme.
strings.Ni entusiasmo sin límites ni miedo conve: Neither limitless enthusiasm nor fear turned into paralysis. We understand technology by testing it with rules, oversight and the ability to stop.
strings.En el primer trimestre de 2025, el 21,1: In the first quarter of 2025, 21.1% of Spanish businesses with ten or more employees used artificial intelligence, 8.7 percentage points more than one year earlier
strings.INE, Encuesta sobre el uso de TIC y come: Spanish National Statistics Institute, survey on ICT use and e-commerce in businesses
strings.El primer entorno controlado español de: Spain's first AI regulatory sandbox concluded in 2026. It received 44 applications, eleven systems completed the programme and the exercise produced sixteen public compliance guides
strings.Ministerio para la Transformación Digita: Ministry for Digital Transformation, conclusion of the first AI regulatory sandbox
strings.AESIA, guías resultantes: Spanish Agency for the Supervision of Artificial Intelligence, resulting guidance
strings.Llevar más usos concretos a entornos con: Bring more specific uses into controlled environments with consent, oversight, decision logs and reversibility. Regulation sets boundaries; testing provides evidence to improve both the product and the rule.
strings.El conocimiento sigue siendo imprescindi: Knowledge remains essential. So does the judgement needed to assess an answer, whether it comes from a person or a machine.
strings.Titulación y encaje no son la misma medi: Qualifications and job fit are different measures.
strings.En 2023, el 52 % de las personas de 25 a: In 2023, 52% of people aged 25 to 34 in Spain had tertiary education, compared with 43% in the European Union. In 2024, 35% of employed people with tertiary education worked in occupations classified by Eurostat as not requiring tertiary education: the highest over-qualification rate in the Union
strings.Eurostat, educación superior en la pobla: Eurostat, tertiary education among people aged 25 to 34
strings.En la evaluación de competencias adultas: In the 2022–2023 adult skills assessment, 31% scored at Level 1 or below in literacy, 30% in numeracy and 35% in adaptive problem solving. The OECD averages were 26%, 25% and 29%, respectively
strings.OCDE, Encuesta de Competencias de Adulto: OECD, Survey of Adult Skills 2023: Spain
AI changes what students need to learn.
strings.El marco de competencias para estudiante: UNESCO's AI competency framework for students explicitly includes critical judgement of AI solutions, citizenship responsibilities, lifelong learning and inclusive design
strings.UNESCO, marco de competencias en IA para: UNESCO, AI competency framework for students
strings.Unir conocimiento, criterio y práctica:: Bring knowledge, judgement and practice together: understand a subject, ask good questions, test evidence, build with others and take responsibility for a decision.
strings.La soberanía tecnológica se mide en capa: Technological sovereignty is measured by the capacity to research, build, operate and scale without a critical dependency.
strings.La Unión Europea representa el 9 % del m: The European Union accounts for 9% of the global semiconductor market, far from its 20% target for 2030. The European Commission considers dependencies on non-EU providers significant in cloud services, cybersecurity and other strategic technologies
strings.Comisión Europea, Estado de la Década Di: European Commission, State of the Digital Decade 2026
strings.En 2025, los especialistas en tecnología: In 2025, information and communication technology specialists represented 5% of employment in the European Union, half the target set for 2030
strings.Soberanía no significa aislamiento. Sign: Sovereignty does not mean isolation. It means a real capacity to choose, audit, replace and maintain essential technology; useful intellectual property; talent that can stay; and companies able to grow from Europe.
strings.Medimos la vivienda habitable, no el anu: We measure habitable homes, not announcements. Between the two lie land, permits, finance, construction and delivery.
strings.Los permisos no siguen el ritmo de los h: Building permits are not keeping pace with household formation.
strings.Entre 2022 y 2024 se concedieron 345.000: Between 2022 and 2024, 345,000 building permits were granted while 604,000 net new households were formed. The OECD review adds that obtaining permits can take up to two years because several levels of government are involved
strings.En el primer trimestre de 2026, el preci: In the first quarter of 2026, house prices rose by 12.9% year on year: 9.1% for new housing and 13.5% for existing housing
strings.INE, Índice de Precios de Vivienda del p: Spanish National Statistics Institute, House Price Index for the first quarter of 2026
strings.En 2025, el 44,3 % de las personas de 26: In 2025, 44.3% of people aged 26 to 34 lived with their parents. Of those, 47.3% said the main reason was that they could not afford to rent or buy a home
strings.INE, Encuesta de Condiciones de Vida 202: Spanish National Statistics Institute, 2025 Living Conditions Survey: access to housing
strings.Reducir, de forma verificable, el tiempo: Reduce, in a measurable way, the time between available land and a habitable home. Make the timetable, accountable person and blockers of every phase visible; test models that increase affordable supply without lowering safety or quality.
strings.La vara de medir no es solo la recaudaci: Tax revenue is not the only yardstick. Nor is digitising a procedure enough if the experience remains slow, opaque or impossible to complete.
strings.Los ingresos tributarios en caja alcanza: Cash-basis tax revenue reached €325.356bn in 2025, 10.4% more than in 2024
User satisfaction has improved, but leaves room to do better.
strings.En 2025, el 62 % de las personas que hab: In 2025, 62% of people who had used administrative services in Spain during the previous twelve months said they were satisfied, up from 57% in 2023
strings.OCDE, Encuesta sobre los determinantes d: OECD, Survey on Drivers of Trust in Public Institutions 2026: Spain
strings.En 2025, España obtuvo 91,87 puntos sobr: In 2025, Spain scored 91.87 out of 100 for digital public services for citizens, above the European Union average of 84.64. Even so, the European Commission recommends improving digitalisation across regions and in the justice system
strings.Comisión Europea, informe de España para: European Commission, Spain's 2026 Digital Decade country report
strings.No convertir el malestar en un superlati: Do not turn frustration into a superlative the data cannot support. Demand something more useful: every procedure with an accountable person, a deadline, visible status, an accessible alternative and end-to-end resolution metrics.
strings.Los ocho problemas son distintos, pero e: The eight problems are different, but the method can be the same: a public baseline, one accountable person, a small test, a measure people can understand and a decision. If the evidence contradicts the idea, change the idea.
strings.Nuestro manifiesto resume el método en c: Our manifesto describes the method in four verbs: AI multiplies, people choose, the system executes and reality validates. Technology speeds up the work; it does not replace judgement or accountability.
strings.No queremos observar una empresa desde f: We do not want to observe a company from the outside and deliver a report. We want to build alongside it.
strings.El trabajo empieza con una persona compr: The work starts with a committed person, a real problem and a willingness to take responsibility. From there, we bring AI infrastructure, product, narrative, operations and funding strategy into one system. Each part must meet a specific project need.
strings.Estamos construyendo Lo que diga la IA e: We are building Lo que diga la IA in public with the same system we want to make available to other projects. Milagro 0 is not yet a success story: it is the first setting in which we can test whether the method improves how we decide and execute. What works will stay. What does not will be corrected or discarded. Progress must be visible in
not depend on our account of it.
strings.Amplía la capacidad de investigar, compa: It expands our capacity to research, compare, create and execute.
strings.Las prioridades, los límites y la respon: Priorities, boundaries and accountability remain human.
strings.Cada decisión se convierte en trabajo co: Every decision becomes concrete work, with a clear owner and visible status.
strings.Los resultados pesan más que el relato;: Outcomes matter more than the story; evidence decides what continues.
strings.Definir un problema concreto, para quién: Define a specific problem, who it matters to and what we will not do.
strings.Reunir evidencia, escuchar a quien vive: Gather evidence, listen to the people who live with the problem and make uncertainty explicit.
strings.Crear la prueba más pequeña que pueda ca: Create the smallest test that could change a decision.
strings.Comparar el resultado con una línea de b: Compare the result with a baseline and publish what did not work, too.
strings.Continuar, corregir o parar. Ninguna pru: Continue, correct or stop. A test is not there to justify an idea in advance.
strings.Compartimos el trabajo con personas disp: We share the work with people willing to care for it and improve it.
strings.Quien abre la puerta ayuda a que la nuev: The person who opens the door helps each newcomer understand the context and find where they can contribute.
Expertise and questions have equal standing.
strings.Quien sabe enseña; quien empieza pregunt: Those who know teach; those who are starting ask. No posturing.
strings.Las ideas, las pruebas y los errores con: Ideas, tests and mistakes can coexist, but the state of the work must remain visible.
strings.Las herramientas, los aprendizajes y los: Tools, lessons and discoveries become more valuable when they circulate.
strings.Una idea se sostiene con evidencia, trab: An idea must stand on evidence, work and results.
strings.Las afinidades pueden convertirse en pro: Shared interests can grow into autonomous projects beyond the group.
strings.El debate mejora las decisiones; el desp: Debate improves decisions; contempt diminishes them.
strings.Entrar no ata y salir no exige una expli: Joining binds no one, and leaving requires no explanation.
strings.Nos importa la IA, pero más aún lo que p: AI matters to us, but what it enables—and whom it serves—matters more.
strings.Si tienes un problema real y estás dispu: If you have a real problem and are ready to work from evidence, start by telling us what you want to change.
strings.Cofundar no depende de una fecha. Es una: Being a cofounder is not determined by a date. It is a way of committing to a problem and taking responsibility for what comes next.
strings.Los fundadores hicieron la primera apues: The founders made the first commitment and provided the initial capital. That beginning opened the way; it did not close the door.
strings.Quien se incorpore dentro de cinco años: Someone who joins five years from now may still be regarded within this community as a cofounder if their contribution materially expands what we are capable of building. Their arrival date matters less than commitment, work and sustained responsibility.
strings.El reconocimiento no nace de la cercanía: Recognition does not come from proximity, visibility or a title. It comes from sustained contribution:
strings.elegir un problema real que importe;: choose a real problem that matters;
strings.aportar criterio, trabajo, capacidad o r: bring judgement, work, capability or resources—not just an opinion;
strings.compartir lo aprendido para que otros pu: share what you learn so others can move forward;
strings.aceptar el debate y cambiar de rumbo cua: accept debate and change course when the evidence demands it;
strings.sostener el compromiso y responder por s: sustain the commitment and take responsibility for its consequences.
You do not need a perfect pitch. Tell us which problem you cannot ignore, what you have learned about it and what you are prepared to contribute.
strings.Podemos empezar por una conversación con: We can begin with a specific conversation and, if there is a fit, a small test with clear responsibility. We will continue only if both sides choose to keep building.
strings.En esta página, «cofundador» describe un: On this page, ‘cofounder’ describes a way of contributing and being recognised. It does not replace any corporate, employment or investment agreement required in each case.
